description: This file contains utility functions for dependency checks and version requirements in the PySpark SQL connect module, including functions to verify minimum versions of dependencies like grpc, grpcio-status, googleapis-common-protos, and zstandard, as well as a function to get the Python version.

methods.name: check_dependencies
methods.description: Checks and enforces minimum versions of dependencies based on the module name.

methods.name: require_minimum_grpc_version
methods.description: Ensures the grpc package is installed and meets the minimum version requirement.

methods.name: require_minimum_grpcio_status_version
methods.description: Ensures the grpcio-status package is installed.

methods.name: require_minimum_googleapis_common_protos_version
methods.description: Ensures the googleapis-common-protos package is installed.

methods.name: require_minimum_zstandard_version
methods.description: Ensures the zstandard package is installed.

methods.name: get_python_ver
methods.description: Returns the current Python version as a string.
